findings.text: follow-on: the predicate's docstring at reckon/_store.py:497 describes the writer's whole form (a leading dot, the target's name, the writing process and a random token, ending in `.tmp`) but the check at :504 is only a leading dot and a `.tmp` suffix, so any `.<anything>.tmp` — including a file merely named `.tmp` — is exempted from the listing arm's report in tests/test_a_pick_sees_each_lanes_burn.py:151. The fragment records this narrowing as an accepted cost with the needle arm closing the material gap, so it is recorded rather than repaired; the docstring reads as a stricter claim than the code makes.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when's two cases both landed and were shown to redden — tests/test_a_pick_sees_each_lanes_burn.py:210 stands a temporary alone and requires the guard to pass, :259 places one beside a stray and requires the stray still be reported — the gate's logs record head `1 failed, 29 passed` EXIT=1 and base `1 failed, 26 passed` EXIT=1 with the same single pre-existing id, and the negative control (filter removed) reddens both new cases at `2 failed, 14 passed` EXIT=1.

The coordinator accepts them at promotion') and which the manifest lists in changed_paths, so every path is either declared or granted.
